summary: Harrow and Vale Distribution Group needs order, inventory and shipment data from SAP ECC, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Manhattan WMS and DHL/UPS/Fastway EDI feeds consolidated onto BigQuery and Looker within 30 weeks, replacing a manual weekly reconciliation across 46 depots; WMS real-time coverage and the historical-migration window remain open.

items.title: Trusted available-to-promise inventory view
items.description: Give merchandising a single, trusted view of available-to-promise inventory across all 46 depots, refreshed at least hourly.

source.quote: BR1. The platform must give merchandising a single, trusted view of available-to-promise inventory across all 46 depots, refreshed at least hourly.

items.title: Eliminate the weekly manual reconciliation
items.description: Eliminate the current weekly manual reconciliation between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS.

source.quote: BR2. The platform must eliminate the current weekly manual reconciliation between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS.

items.title: Two-week-ahead stockout forecasting
items.description: Let supply chain planners forecast depot-level stockouts at least two weeks in advance.

source.quote: BR3. The platform should let supply chain planners forecast depot-level stockouts at least two weeks in advance.

items.title: Consolidated order, margin and carrier-cost view
items.description: Give finance a consolidated view of order value, margin and carrier cost by depot and by trade account.

source.quote: BR4. The platform must give finance a consolidated view of order value, margin and carrier cost by depot and by trade account.

items.title: Customer-facing order tracking (future candidate)
items.description: A future customer-facing order-tracking experience is a candidate but explicitly out of scope for this phase.

source.quote: BR5. The platform could support a future customer-facing order-tracking experience, though that is not in scope for this phase.

items.title: Near-real-time SAP ECC order ingestion
items.description: Ingest sales order and order-line data from SAP ECC, including order status changes, at least every 15 minutes.

source.quote: FR1. The platform must ingest sales order and order-line data from SAP ECC, including order status changes, at least every 15 minutes.

items.title: Daily Salesforce account and opportunity ingestion
items.description: Ingest wholesale account and opportunity data from Salesforce Sales Cloud daily.

source.quote: FR2. The platform must ingest wholesale account and opportunity data from Salesforce Sales Cloud daily.

items.title: Near-real-time Manhattan WMS event ingestion
items.description: Ingest pick, pack and stock-on-hand events from Manhattan WMS in near real time across all 46 depots.

source.quote: FR3. The platform must ingest pick, pack and stock-on-hand events from Manhattan WMS in near real time across all 46 depots.

items.title: Carrier EDI message parsing
items.description: Parse and load EDI 214 and EDI 856 carrier messages delivered over SFTP from DHL, UPS and Fastway.

source.quote: FR4. The platform must parse and load EDI 214 and EDI 856 carrier messages delivered over SFTP from DHL, UPS and Fastway.

items.title: Automated inventory reconciliation
items.description: Reconcile inventory positions between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS automatically and surface variances above a configurable threshold.

source.quote: FR5. The platform must reconcile inventory positions between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS automatically and surface variances above a configurable threshold.

items.title: Margin and carrier-cost reporting
items.description: Finance analysts build margin and carrier-cost reports blended from SAP ECC order data and carrier EDI cost fields.

source.quote: FR7. Finance analysts must be able to build margin and carrier-cost reports blended from SAP ECC order data and carrier EDI cost fields.

items.title: Data-steward correction workflow
items.description: Data stewards see and correct records that fail data-quality validation before they reach reporting layers.

source.quote: FR9. Data stewards must be able to see and correct records that fail data-quality validation before they reach reporting layers.

items.title: Twelve-month trailing stockout forecast
items.description: Let supply chain planners build a depot-level stockout forecast using at least twelve months of trailing order history.

source.quote: FR6. Supply chain planners must be able to build a depot-level stockout forecast using at least twelve months of trailing order history.

items.title: Ad hoc Looker dashboards without data engineering
items.description: Let merchandising build ad hoc dashboards in Looker without needing data-engineering support for every new question.

source.quote: FR8. The platform should let merchandising build ad hoc dashboards in Looker without needing data-engineering support for every new question.

items.title: Full data lineage trail
items.description: Maintain a full lineage trail showing which source system and load run produced every reported metric.

source.quote: FR10. The platform must maintain a full lineage trail showing which source system and load run produced every reported metric.

items.title: 40,000 SAP order-line changes per day at peak
items.description: Support 40,000 SAP ECC order-line changes per day at peak, including the pre-Christmas trading period, without backlog.

source.quote: NFR1. The platform must support 40,000 SAP ECC order-line changes per day at peak, including the pre-Christmas trading period, without backlog.

items.title: 60-minute inventory dashboard refresh
items.description: Depot-level inventory dashboards must refresh within 60 minutes of a source-system change during business hours.

source.quote: NFR2. Depot-level inventory dashboards must refresh within 60 minutes of a source-system change during business hours.

items.title: Approximately 350 named users
items.description: Support approximately 350 named users across merchandising, supply chain and finance.

source.quote: NFR3. The platform must support approximately 350 named users across merchandising, supply chain and finance.

items.title: Six-year transaction-level retention
items.description: Retain transaction-level order and shipment data for at least six years to satisfy UK tax and audit requirements.

source.quote: NFR5. The platform must retain transaction-level order and shipment data for at least six years to satisfy UK tax and audit requirements.

items.title: Idempotent EDI file processing
items.description: EDI file processing must be idempotent so a resent or duplicate carrier file never double-counts a shipment.

source.quote: NFR6. EDI file processing must be idempotent so a resent or duplicate carrier file never double-counts a shipment.

items.title: 2% SAP/WMS variance-flagging threshold
items.description: Flag any depot with more than a 2% variance between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS stock counts within the same reporting cycle.

source.quote: NFR4. Data-quality checks must flag any depot with more than a 2% variance between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS stock counts within the same reporting cycle.

items.title: SAP ECC batch integration
items.description: Batch integration with SAP ECC for order, order-line and finance postings, using SAP-provided extract tables or IDocs.

source.quote: INT1. Batch integration with SAP ECC for order, order-line and finance postings, using SAP-provided extract tables or IDocs.

items.title: Manhattan WMS event-driven integration
items.description: Event-driven integration with Manhattan WMS for pick, pack and stock-on-hand events, ideally via its published event stream.

source.quote: INT2. Event-driven integration with Manhattan WMS for pick, pack and stock-on-hand events, ideally via the WMS's published event stream.

items.title: Salesforce Sales Cloud batch integration
items.description: Daily batch integration with Salesforce Sales Cloud for wholesale account and opportunity data.

source.quote: INT3. Daily batch integration with Salesforce Sales Cloud for wholesale account and opportunity data.

items.title: Carrier SFTP file integration
items.description: File-based SFTP integration to receive EDI 214 and EDI 856 messages from DHL, UPS and Fastway on a schedule agreed with each carrier.

source.quote: INT4. File-based SFTP integration to receive EDI 214 and EDI 856 messages from DHL, UPS and Fastway on a schedule agreed with each carrier.

items.title: Okta staff authentication for Looker
items.description: Integrate with the existing Okta tenant for staff authentication into Looker and any data-steward tooling.

source.quote: INT6. The platform must integrate with our existing Okta tenant for staff authentication into Looker and any data-steward tooling.

items.title: Future customer-tracking shipment-status API (candidate)
items.description: Expose a secure API so a future customer-tracking experience can query shipment status; this build is out of scope for the current phase.

source.quote: INT5. The platform should expose a secure API so a future customer-tracking experience can query shipment status, though that build is out of scope now.

items.title: Conformed dimensional model
items.description: Model order, inventory and shipment data into a governed set of conformed dimensions (depot, product, carrier, trade account) usable across all reports.

source.quote: DATA1. Order, inventory and shipment data must be modelled into a governed set of conformed dimensions (depot, product, carrier, trade account) usable across all reports.

items.title: Domain-based data ownership
items.description: Assign data ownership per domain: supply chain owns inventory and shipment data, finance owns order and margin data.

source.quote: DATA2. Data ownership must be assigned per domain: supply chain owns inventory and shipment data, finance owns order and margin data.

items.title: Automated data-quality rules
items.description: Check for missing SKU mappings, negative stock quantities and orphaned shipment records on every load.

source.quote: DATA3. Data quality rules must check for missing SKU mappings, negative stock quantities and orphaned shipment records on every load.

items.title: SAP/WMS product and depot master-data reconciliation
items.description: Reconcile master product and depot reference data between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS, since SKU codes differ slightly between the two systems today.

source.quote: DATA4. Master product and depot reference data must be reconciled between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS, since SKU codes differ slightly between the two systems today.

items.title: Salesforce trade-account contact data
items.description: Trade-account data from Salesforce contains personal contact details for account owners and must be handled as confidential business data.

source.quote: DATA6. Trade-account data from Salesforce contains personal contact details for account owners and must be handled as confidential business data.

items.title: Six-year transaction retention with indefinite marts
items.description: Retain transaction-level detail for six years; aggregated reporting marts may be retained indefinitely.

source.quote: DATA5. Transaction-level detail must be retained for six years; aggregated reporting marts may be retained indefinitely.

items.title: Encryption in transit
items.description: Encrypt all data in transit between depots, carriers and the analytics platform using current TLS standards.

source.quote: SEC1. All data in transit between depots, carriers and the analytics platform must be encrypted using current TLS standards.

items.title: Role-based access to margin data
items.description: Restrict depot-level margin data to finance and senior supply chain roles only via role-based access control.

source.quote: SEC2. Role-based access control must restrict depot-level margin data to finance and senior supply chain roles only.

items.title: Managed SFTP credential rotation
items.description: Store SFTP credentials for each carrier in a managed secrets service and rotate them at least every 90 days.

source.quote: SEC3. SFTP credentials for each carrier must be stored in a managed secrets service and rotated at least every 90 days.

items.title: Audit trail for manual corrections
items.description: Record every manual data-quality correction in an audit trail, including who made it and when.

source.quote: SEC4. An audit trail must record every manual data-quality correction, including who made it and when.

items.title: UK GDPR handling for trade-account contacts
items.description: Support UK GDPR requirements for the personal contact data held in the Salesforce trade-account extracts.

source.quote: SEC5. The platform must support UK GDPR requirements for the personal contact data held in the Salesforce trade-account extracts.

items.title: BigQuery warehouse for Looker
items.description: The BI team has standardised on Looker for dashboards and wants the underlying warehouse to be BigQuery so Looker's native modelling layer can be used directly.

source.quote: TECH1. Our BI team has standardised on Looker for dashboards and would like the underlying warehouse to be BigQuery so Looker's native modelling layer can be used directly.

items.title: No existing analytics cloud footprint
items.description: There is currently no cloud footprint for analytics, so the delivery partner should recommend the supporting pipeline and orchestration services.

source.quote: TECH2. We currently have no cloud footprint for analytics, so the delivery partner should recommend the supporting data-pipeline and orchestration services rather than assume Google Cloud is a given beyond the warehouse and BI layer.

items.title: SQL-first transformation preference
items.description: The two in-house data analysts know SQL and Python; a platform that keeps transformation logic in SQL where practical is preferred.

source.quote: TECH3. Our two in-house data analysts know SQL and Python; a platform that keeps transformation logic in SQL where practical is preferred.

items.title: 30-week pre-peak go-live target
items.description: Be live and reconciling SAP ECC against Manhattan WMS before the pre-Christmas peak trading period, a target of 30 weeks from contract signature.

source.quote: CON1. The platform must be live and reconciling SAP ECC against Manhattan WMS before our pre-Christmas peak trading period begins, which the program sponsor has set at 30 weeks from contract signature.

items.title: Phased depot rollout
items.description: Roll out to the five largest depots by order volume before extending to the remaining 41.

source.quote: CON2. Depot rollout should be phased, starting with our five largest depots by order volume before extending to the remaining 41.

items.title: Half-time customer data analyst; partner owns data engineering
items.description: The customer's data team can allocate one data analyst half-time to this program; the delivery partner is expected to own data engineering and pipeline build.

source.quote: CON3. Our data team can allocate one data analyst half-time to this program; the delivery partner is expected to own data engineering and pipeline build.

items.title: Retire legacy reconciliation spreadsheet within 90 days
items.description: Formally retire the legacy Access-based reconciliation spreadsheet within 90 days of the new platform going live.

source.quote: CON4. The legacy Access-based reconciliation spreadsheet must be formally retired within 90 days of the new platform going live.

items.title: SAP ECC
items.description: The order-management and finance system of record, running on-premises, generating roughly 40,000 sales order changes per day.

source.quote: SAP ECC is our order-management and finance system of record, running on-premises, and generates roughly 40,000 sales order changes per day.

items.title: Salesforce Sales Cloud
items.description: Holds wholesale account and opportunity data for the 1,200 trade accounts the field sales team manages.

source.quote: Salesforce Sales Cloud holds our wholesale account and opportunity data for the 1,200 trade accounts our field sales team manages.

items.title: Manhattan Associates WMS
items.description: The warehouse management system deployed across all 46 depots and the source of truth for pick, pack and stock-on-hand events.

source.quote: Our warehouse management system is Manhattan Associates WMS, deployed across all 46 depots, and is the source of truth for pick, pack and stock-on-hand events.

items.title: Carrier EDI Feeds (DHL, UPS, Fastway)
items.description: Carrier shipment tracking arrives as EDI 214 and EDI 856 messages over SFTP from the three main carriers.

source.quote: Carrier shipment tracking arrives as EDI 214 and EDI 856 messages over SFTP from our three main carriers: DHL, UPS and a regional Irish carrier called Fastway.

items.title: Legacy Access-Based Reconciliation Spreadsheet
items.description: A legacy Access-based spreadsheet process currently reconciles SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS stock counts weekly; the COO wants it eliminated.

source.quote: A legacy Access-based spreadsheet process is currently used to reconcile SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS stock counts weekly, which the COO wants eliminated entirely.

items.title: Supply Chain Planner
items.description: Plans depot-level stock and forecasts stockouts using consolidated inventory and order data.

source.quote: BR3. The platform should let supply chain planners forecast depot-level stockouts at least two weeks in advance.

items.title: Finance Analyst
items.description: Builds margin and carrier-cost reports blended from order and EDI cost data.

source.quote: FR7. Finance analysts must be able to build margin and carrier-cost reports blended from SAP ECC order data and carrier EDI cost fields.

items.title: Merchandiser
items.description: Merchandising staff who need a trusted, hourly view of available-to-promise inventory and build their own Looker dashboards.

source.quote: BR1. The platform must give merchandising a single, trusted view of available-to-promise inventory across all 46 depots, refreshed at least hourly.

items.title: Data Steward
items.description: Data stewards who review and correct records that fail data-quality validation before they reach reporting.

source.quote: FR9. Data stewards must be able to see and correct records that fail data-quality validation before they reach reporting layers.

items.title: Fastway EDI feed reliability history
items.description: Extra validation is needed on the Fastway carrier feed given its history of reliability issues, which may add reconciliation logic before go-live.

source.quote: The Head of Supply Chain flagged that Fastway's EDI feed has historically been the least reliable of the three carriers and asked for extra validation on that feed specifically.

items.title: SKU mapping mismatch risk
items.description: Diverging SKU codes between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS create a risk of inaccurate reconciliation until master data is aligned.

source.quote: DATA4. Master product and depot reference data must be reconciled between SAP ECC and Manhattan WMS, since SKU codes differ slightly between the two systems today.

items.title: Duplicate-shipment risk without idempotent processing
items.description: A resent or duplicate carrier EDI file could double-count a shipment if idempotent processing is not implemented as specified.

source.quote: NFR6. EDI file processing must be idempotent so a resent or duplicate carrier file never double-counts a shipment.

items.title: Manhattan WMS real-time coverage unconfirmed
items.description: It is unconfirmed whether Manhattan WMS can publish real-time stock events at all 46 depots or only the 12 depots on the newer WMS version.

source.quote: It is still unconfirmed whether Manhattan WMS can publish real-time stock events at all 46 depots or only at the 12 depots on the newer WMS version; the BI Manager will confirm with the WMS vendor.

items.title: Historical migration window undecided
items.description: No decision has been made on whether historical data migration should go back three years or the full six-year retention window at initial load.

source.quote: No decision has been made on whether historical data migration should go back three years or the full six-year retention window at initial load.

items.title: Target phase for the customer-tracking API not set
items.description: The customer defers the shipment-status API for a future customer-tracking experience past this phase but has not said which later phase should deliver it.

source.quote: INT5. The platform should expose a secure API so a future customer-tracking experience can query shipment status, though that build is out of scope now.

items.title: Delivery partner recommends surrounding GCP services
items.description: Assumed the delivery partner can recommend supporting GCP services (pipeline orchestration, ingestion) beyond BigQuery and Looker, given no existing cloud footprint.

source.quote: TECH2. We currently have no cloud footprint for analytics, so the delivery partner should recommend the supporting data-pipeline and orchestration services rather than assume Google Cloud is a given beyond the warehouse and BI layer.

items.title: Depot ranking derivable from SAP ECC data
items.description: Assumed the five largest depots by order volume can be identified from existing SAP ECC sales data without a separate depot-ranking exercise.

source.quote: CON2. Depot rollout should be phased, starting with our five largest depots by order volume before extending to the remaining 41.

items.title: Can Manhattan WMS publish real-time events at all 46 depots?
items.description: Confirm whether Manhattan WMS can publish real-time stock events at all 46 depots or only the 12 depots on the newer WMS version.

source.quote: It is still unconfirmed whether Manhattan WMS can publish real-time stock events at all 46 depots or only at the 12 depots on the newer WMS version; the BI Manager will confirm with the WMS vendor.

items.title: How far back should historical migration go?
items.description: Confirm whether historical data migration should cover three years or the full six-year retention window at initial load.

source.quote: No decision has been made on whether historical data migration should go back three years or the full six-year retention window at initial load.

items.title: Confirm the target phase for the customer-tracking API
items.description: The customer places the customer-tracking API outside this phase; confirm which later phase should deliver it so it can be planned and estimated then.

source.quote: INT5. The platform should expose a secure API so a future customer-tracking experience can query shipment status, though that build is out of scope now.
